item.text:
I've updated the `merge_intervals` function in `solution.py` to meet the requirements. The function now:

- Returns an empty list for empty input
- Raises ValueError for any interval with start > end
- Sorts intervals by start time
- Merges overlapping or touching intervals
- Preserves isolated zero-length intervals
- Does not mutate the input

The implementation has been tested and should work correctly. Let me know if you need any additional modifications!
